== Welcome,  FiF! ==
[[File:WOTcalendarlogo.png|right|375px]]
Hello, and [[Wikipedia:Welcome, newcomers|welcome]] to '''A Wheel of Time Wiki'''!. Thanks for your edit to the [[:User:FiF]] page. I hope you like the place and decide to stay. Here are a few good links for newcomers:

* '''Local:'''
**[[Help:Style guide|Detailed style guide (in progress)]]
**[[project:Be bold|Be bold! We need your help!]]
**[[Help:Edit_summary|Leave an edit summary when you make changes]]
**[[Help:Contents|All help pages]]
*'''Wikipedia:'''
**[[m:Help:Editing|How to edit a page]]
**[[Wikipedia:Wikipedia:Tutorial|Tutorial]]
**[[Wikipedia:Wikipedia:Five pillars|The five pillars of Wikipedia]]
**[[Wikipedia:Wikipedia:How to write a great article|How to write a great article]]

I hope you enjoy editing here and helping us get this project started. By the way, please be sure to [[Help:Sign_your_posts_on_talk_pages|Sign your comments on talk pages]], using four tildes (&#126;&#126;&#126;&#126;) to produce your name and the current date, or three tildes (&#126;&#126;&#126;) for just your name. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact [[:Category:Administrators|one of us]] for more information! -- [[User:Mainphramephreak|Mainphramephreak]] ([[User_talk:Mainphramephreak|Talk]]) 12:07, January 6, 2011
